reasons: All three of A's variants are idiomatic and keep all three meanings: speed, nothing broken and quiet nights, including the vivid on-call image «без ночных будильников». B's third variant «Запускай. Не ломай. Спи.» drops 'faster' and turns 'sleep at night' into a bare «Спи», losing the peace-of-mind sense. B also wrongly claims each beat has three syllables, but «Спи» has only one.
